statement: Each price is the executed price of one swap in the named xStock/USDC pool, read from the public Solana ledger. It is not a quote, a bid or ask, or a reference price.

method.close_slot: the first slot whose block time is at or after the session close in America/New_York
method.selection: the successful pool transaction nearest the close slot (slot distance, then the earlier slot, then the transaction nearest the close within the slot) that is proven to be a single swap
method.single_swap_proof: the transaction moves the pool's xStock and USDC vaults in opposite directions and exactly two token transfers touch the vaults, one in and one out, each for the full change
method.price: usdc_per_unscaled_token = |USDC vault change| / 10^usdc_decimals divided by |xStock vault change| / 10^xstock_decimals; the Scaled UI multiplier is not applied; truncated to 6 fraction digits
method.per_share: usdc_per_underlying_share = usdc_per_unscaled_token / multiplier, only for trades at or after multiplier_basis.known_from; the issuer defines one displayed unit (raw x multiplier) as one underlying share

sources.finding: Holidays and 1:00 p.m. early closes for 2026 as listed on the exchange page.
The page now lists 2026 to 2028 only; the 2025 dates are the exchange's previously published 2025 schedule and were not re-read from the page.
